what: The ▶ at the right of a fixed-width uppercase pill button. On hover, over .35s (ease-out) it is clipped away to the right across its first 40%, then redrawn from the left edge starting at the left. In the same .35s the text shifts right by that amount (left and right padding change) and the rounded pill turns into a square-cornered rectangle (cubic-bezier(.17,.17,.2,1)). After one hover, on leave the ▶ crosses back in reverse to the right-hand position

options.look: plain: ▶ A button with sharp corners only and no arrow (a head button like Contact)
options.--fx-bg · --fx-ink: Button background and text color (via style), default var(--kf-ink) · var(--kf-bg)

note: The part js only adds a ”hand has touched” marker (is-fx-touched). Without it, the ▶ plays a reverse-crossing animation on first open (the original’s btn--interacted). On phones (no hover) it stays still.

from.where: shared.css .an-btn (all the black pill buttons such as Browse work · Browse services · Contact — original .btn · btn-icon-move-in/out keyframes · the .no-icon header button is look: plain)
